results.title: Aliens in the Office
results.overview: A young telemarketer is introduced to a new Co-worker. He begins to watch him as he settles in, and what he finds will tear everyone in the office far far apart...

results.title: Medeni Haller
results.overview: Between love, marriage, and freedom, everyone has a “marital status.”

results.title: TOE′S
results.overview: After injuring his pinky toe while working at a distribution center, Mingi receives a mysterious package. Inside is something unexpected, something he could never have imagined.

results.title: The Distant Home
results.overview: Su-a arrives in Yangsan to visit her grandmother, but she is not home. The old lady is not someone with many places to go - just the bathhouse or the Buddhist temple.

results.title: Afternoon on the Bridge
results.overview: A sad-looking man stands under a bridge cutting across the heart of city. When he skillfully skips stones, a woman watching him from the other side throws stones into the water.

results.title: Annyeong, Stellar
results.overview: Goonamgua yeo riding Stellar a band that began at the cafe and bar Goonamgwayeo in Hoegi, Seoul, in 2005, has spent 20 years making music that mixes trot, garage, dub, and electronic sounds - music that fits into no genre lineage. But in September 2025, the band announced its breakup with a statement: "We are trying to stop the weird car that seemed as though it would run forever." Then they set off on a 'Annyeong Tour' from Sokcho to Jeju.

results.title: A Life of an Artist: Kwon Jinkyu
results.overview: Kwon Jinkyu (1922-1973) was a sculptor who is regarded to have brought modern sculpture in Korea to fruition, opening the way to contemporary sculpture. Leaving behind over 420 pieces of work in terracotta and dry lacquer, he stands alongside painters Park Soo-Keun and Lee Jung-sub as one of Korea's foremost artists, yet he was never properly recognized in his lifetime.

results.title: Kim Yun Shin Punches In
results.overview: Born in Wonsan in 1935, Kim is one of Korea's first-generation female sculptors. At 49, she gave up her professorship and left for Argentina, spending the next 40 years working in South America, following trees, stones, and raw gemstones. Then, at 90, she returned to Korea.

results.title: Can I Talk to You?
results.overview: On a city street at night, a barefoot teenage girl with the legs of her sweatpants rolled up lights a cigarette and sticks it between her lips before connecting to the probation office's voice monitoring system. "Four, five, six, seven, four, five, six, seven…" She repeats the meaningless numbers requested by the system aloud. Her face is never shown, yet we can almost see her expression.

results.title: Agaar
results.overview: Agaar, a young shepherd in Inner Mongolia, is a modern youth who believes that traditional herding cannot get him his dream car - a BMW. He once learned English online, got a job on a cruise ship, and traveled around the Caribbean. For ambitious Agaar, the grassland is too small. He tries to change its future with a smartphone and the internet.

results.title: ACROSS: Anatomy of the Forgotten War
results.overview: Scene 1: Cannelle, a human rights lawyer based in Berlin, is pursuing a case on war crimes in Yemen at the European Center for Constitutional and Human Rights (ECCHR). Scene 2: In Sardinia, Italy, STOP RWM activists continue their campaign against the illegal expansion of the German arms manufacturer RWM on the island and its arms exports. Scene 3: Jamal, a former civil servant in Yemen, arrives with his family in Jeju after fleeing the Houthi rebels. Linking Europe, the Middle East, and Korea, these three scenes, which evoke the opening of a large-scale political thriller, arouse both tension and curiosity. At their intersection lies the (forgotten) war in Yemen.

results.title: 771 Days
results.overview: "Mom made it home alive from the street protest again today!" As soon as Zainab Entezar opens the door to her home and walks in, she is greeted by her young son and embraces him. She goes to the women’s street protests as though heading to work, and every time she leaves home, she fears she may never see her son again.

results.title: Deep Blue
results.overview: At 11 years old, Nicola has killed a man. It was his father, Lucio, who ordered him to do it. His reward? Abandonment. Twenty years have passed, and since that day Nicola has lived in Mexico with his uncle Nando, who raised him under a lie: Lucio was dead. A harsh upbringing in a ruthless country shaped him and taught him how to survive. Today, he's an adult working at the family restaurant, having buried the past under the weight of distance. But Nando decides to leave for good. On the eve of his escape, he chooses to reveal the truth: Nicola's father is still alive.

results.title: Khoriya
results.overview: Two Nepali half-brothers run a poultry farm on the outskirts of a city. The older brother wants to expand the farm, while the younger dreams of becoming a soldier and settling down with his girlfriend. When their livelihood is threatened by an outbreak of the avian flu, the older brother turns to the illegal trade of steroids by targeting military recruits, and drags his younger brother into the business. His girlfriend, who works in the beauty industry, decides to leave for Dubai in search of bigger opportunities.

results.title: Midday Meal
results.overview: In a parched badland village that looks like the end of the world, Solan is the only teacher. After years of enduring the poorly paid temporary job, he holds one modest dream - to become a full-time teacher and to live in a proper house with his mother. But everything begins to unravel with the death of the benefactor who had funded the school’s meal program.

results.title: 144 – Apocalypse Not
results.overview: After a satirical tweet targeting Bolsonaro and the Universal Church, J.P. Cuenca became the target of 144 lawsuits and thousands of death threats from the evangelical far right. Seeking dialogue, he embarks on an 11,000-kilometer journey through packed churches, rodeos, German festivals, shooting clubs, home worship services, and gospel trucks across every region of Brazil. Amid ecological devastation, religious fervor, and an impending apocalypse, a Brazil in trance reaches an apotheosis of color, music, and faith.

results.title: Dog without Feathers
results.overview: From the Agreste to the sea, the Capibaribe River inspires the poetry of João Cabral de Melo Neto and the dance of Deborah Colker. This documentary is a road movie in which performance, the body, and poetry fuel a journey that begins at the river’s source and flows out to the open sea, moving between the arid landscape and the ocean, between devastation and what endures.

results.title: Espwa Haiti: Against All Odds
results.overview: ESPWA (Hope in French Creole) is a feature-length documentary that explores the role of Haitian artists as guardians of the nation's voice at a time when national institutions and governance are absent or failing. The film examines Haiti's history and the repercussions of the recent assassination of President Jovenel Moïse as the country attempts to rebuild itself on the path to security and prosperity. Espwa is a story of resilience, offering exclusive access to the account of Joverlein Moïse, the assassinated president's son, who shares his testimony for the first time.

results.title: Santo
results.overview: A traffic accident brings two young delivery riders together in São Paulo. Yuri, free-spirited and provocative, and Davi, hardworking and guided by his faith, find themselves caught between religion and the freedom of the streets.
